policy: Before adding any private runtime plugin or managed N.E.K.O core patch, review N.E.K.O native/upstream capability and mature external components. Reuse wins unless a concrete acceptance gap remains. run_checks.ps1 fails closed when a runtime customization lacks an approved review.

reviews.problem: Internal proactive session start incorrectly refreshes user-activity authority.

candidates.name: N.E.K.O native proactive runtime
candidates.outcome: gap_is_inside_authority

reviews.why_reuse_insufficient: This is an internal N.E.K.O lifecycle race; an external component cannot repair the authority ordering without replacing the runtime.

reviews.problem: Full Chat hides the already-native microphone control.

candidates.name: N.E.K.O native microphone/realtime runtime
candidates.outcome: reused; only UI bridge missing

reviews.why_reuse_insufficient: Native runtime is reused; patch only exposes its existing control in the active surface.

reviews.problem: Qwen3.8 semantic VAD accepted PCM without completing speech detection in live E2E.

candidates.name: Qwen3.8 server_vad
candidates.outcome: selected

reviews.why_reuse_insufficient: Uses provider-native server VAD; only N.E.K.O's model-specific selection needed correction.

reviews.problem: User PCM activity is published too late when the shared worker is backpressured.

candidates.name: N.E.K.O native user-priority/activity signal
candidates.outcome: reused but emitted too late

reviews.why_reuse_insufficient: External VAD/ASR cannot fix the internal queue/lock ordering; patch reuses the same native RMS signal before queueing.

reviews.problem: Rapid character switching can drop the latest intent and leave the VRM torn down.

candidates.name: N.E.K.O native character/VRM renderer
candidates.outcome: reused; state-machine recovery missing

reviews.why_reuse_insufficient: The bug is in N.E.K.O's own switch state machine; replacing the renderer would be larger and duplicate more functionality.

reviews.problem: An independent assistant-speech mute can create policy-induced text-only replies; the required contract is one whole-reply quiet gate before text/TTS split.

candidates.name: N.E.K.O existing text publication + TTS output paths
candidates.outcome: reused; no native single admission boundary exposed to the private plugin

reviews.why_reuse_insufficient: The native text and TTS pipelines are reused unchanged after admission. The narrow patch only supplies the missing opt-in common boundary so private quiet intent cannot split text from its paired audio.

reviews.problem: Qwen3.8 auto tool selection skips a negative recent-activity question.

candidates.name: Qwen3.8-Omni native tool_choice with reasoning_effort=none
candidates.outcome: verified 1/1 for previously failing case; preferred execution mechanism

candidates.name: N.E.K.O plugin SDK @llm_tool
candidates.outcome: registration reused; no synchronous per-turn tool-choice arbitration hook

reviews.why_reuse_insufficient: Provider-native forced tool is used directly. The remaining patch is only a generic per-turn bridge because N.E.K.O has no configuration/plugin hook to select first-round tool_choice from private policy and then restore ordinary reasoning.

reviews.problem: Owner interaction controls need deterministic native state changes without a permanent high-frequency polling loop; retrospective activity still needs a queryable local authority.

candidates.name: N.E.K.O conversations_v2 watcher
candidates.outcome: selected for text user-turn observation; role=user,input_source=text, view_limit=20

candidates.name: N.E.K.O proactive_controller and conversation settings
candidates.outcome: selected as hard execution authority

candidates.name: ActivityWatch 0.14.3
candidates.outcome: selected as recent-activity authority; no private duplicate timeline

candidates.name: N.E.K.O Plugin SDK model gateway (ctx.models)
candidates.outcome: selected in plugin 0.6.6 for semantic classification; interaction_classifier is host-managed and bound to the native agent_small host-follow slot, so the private plugin no longer reads provider credentials or constructs its own LLM client

candidates.name: N.E.K.O Plugin SDK SystemInfo/settings surface
candidates.outcome: still read-only for this need on N.E.K.O 6fccfb72: get_system_config/get_server_settings exist, but no SDK conversation-settings CAS writer is exposed. Keep the narrow native /api/config/conversation-settings adapter for explicit owner vision-consent changes.

reviews.why_reuse_insufficient: Text observation uses N.E.K.O conversations_v2; semantic classification now uses the native Plugin SDK model gateway on agent_small; hard proactive execution uses proactive_controller; retrospective activity uses ActivityWatch. The only remaining direct host adapter is the native conversation-settings CAS route for explicit owner vision-consent changes because the current Plugin SDK settings surface is read-only for that user-owned field.

reviews.problem: XiaoYu needs a first-class paired Qwen clone, and preview/conversation/realtime must share one persisted speech-rate authority rather than diverging.

candidates.name: N.E.K.O existing structured character voice storage/picker
candidates.outcome: selected as the only local voice binding and UI authority

candidates.name: N.E.K.O existing Qwen3.8 Omni realtime transport
candidates.outcome: selected for realtime speech; paired cloned voice is passed only on exact provider/model match

candidates.name: Alibaba Model Studio Qwen-Audio voice enrollment and TTS HTTP APIs
candidates.outcome: selected for ordinary clone creation, text synthesis and preview

candidates.name: Alibaba Model Studio Qwen Omni voice enrollment API
candidates.outcome: selected for the matching Qwen3.8 Omni realtime clone created from the same reference sample

candidates.name: Generic N.E.K.O CosyVoice preview path
candidates.outcome: rejected for qwen_bundle after live preview returned InvalidParameter / engine 418

candidates.name: Legacy qwen3-tts-vc-realtime-2026-01-15
candidates.outcome: rejected after live provider response: model no longer exists

candidates.name: N.E.K.O / audiolab existing tempo pipeline
candidates.outcome: selected for pitch-preserving speech-rate application; no custom DSP implementation

reviews.why_reuse_insufficient: Durable authorities remain reused: N.E.K.O owns voice storage/picking/runtime, Alibaba owns enrollment and synthesis, and audiolab owns pitch-preserving tempo. The thin patch only exposes paired enrollment/routing, binds one shared speech_rate to those native paths, and refreshes the matching TTS worker when it changes.

reviews.problem: The owner can be interrupted by entertainment/ambient proactive output while actively gaming or otherwise busy because an early activity snapshot may be misclassified or become stale before final delivery.

candidates.name: N.E.K.O system_presence / system_presence_windows
candidates.outcome: selected after 899a08ce upgrade for sleep, session lock, display-off and post-return quiet-window suppression; it complements rather than duplicates QUNS because it does not expose BUSY, D3D fullscreen, presentation or quiet-time notification-propriety states

candidates.name: Windows SHQueryUserNotificationState
candidates.outcome: selected as the external hard receptivity veto for BUSY, D3D fullscreen, presentation, not-present, and quiet-time states

candidates.name: N.E.K.O SystemSignalCollector + ActivitySnapshot
candidates.outcome: selected as the only activity/receptivity state authority; final delivery reuses get_snapshot_sync rather than adding another detector

candidates.name: N.E.K.O ActivityPreferences.work_break_game_invite_probability
candidates.outcome: selected to keep focused-work break reminders from pivoting into game invitations; value remains 0.0

candidates.name: ActivityWatch 0.14.3
candidates.outcome: retained as retrospective/local activity evidence; not promoted to final interruption authority because it observes apps/AFK rather than notification propriety

candidates.name: Playnite OnGameStarted/OnGameStopped
candidates.outcome: not integrated because Playnite is not installed on this machine; keep as a future optional high-confidence game-session signal rather than introducing a new dependency

candidates.name: N.E.K.O PluginCatalog + PluginRunner
candidates.outcome: selected for optional capability-provider discovery and shadow execution; hidden plugin entries reuse the existing plugin process/lifecycle/IPC path instead of a private registry or second broker

reviews.why_reuse_insufficient: N.E.K.O 899a08ce system_presence is reused for sleep/lock/display-off/return gating; SystemSignalCollector + ActivitySnapshot remain the activity authority; PluginCatalog/PluginRunner remain the provider lifecycle/discovery/execution path. The narrow residual patch only adds the non-overlapping Windows QUNS busy/fullscreen/presentation signal, final-delivery native snapshot recheck, leisure-only game admission, and non-authoritative interruptibility_v1 shadow observation. No second presence watcher, game database, plugin host, registry or model call is introduced.

reviews.problem: Measured event-loop stalls came from first heavy SDK/plugin imports, blocking filesystem/config work, and repeated localhost/external httpx client setup across main/agent/memory startup paths.

candidates.name: N.E.K.O main background preload + native TokenTracker
candidates.outcome: selected; OpenAI hook installation is moved off-loop while periodic save and accounting stay on each owning asyncio loop

candidates.name: N.E.K.O embedded plugin-server isolated thread
candidates.outcome: selected; only its first module import is preloaded off the agent loop, then the existing isolated server thread remains authoritative

candidates.name: N.E.K.O utils.http.internal_client / utils.internal_http_client
candidates.outcome: selected for localhost plugin IPC/search/capability checks; replaces per-call AsyncClient and the duplicate XiaoYu search SSLContext cache

candidates.name: N.E.K.O utils.http.external_client
candidates.outcome: selected for client registration; preserves proof/redirect policy while reusing N.E.K.O's pooled TLS client

candidates.name: Python asyncio.to_thread
candidates.outcome: selected only for blocking imports/filesystem/config preparation with no async native API

candidates.name: httpx connection pooling
candidates.outcome: reused through N.E.K.O shared clients; no XiaoYu pool or TLS lifecycle is added

reviews.why_reuse_insufficient: N.E.K.O native TokenTracker, embedded plugin thread, internal HTTP client and external pooled HTTP client are reused directly. The residual patch only moves their uncovered first-import/filesystem/config/lazy-client construction boundaries off the event loop. The 899a08ce live cold restart proved the former client_registration -> SSLContext application stall no longer recurs; no private HTTP pool or SSL cache exists.

reviews.problem: Three new upstream commits landed immediately after the 899a08ce promotion and overlap XiaoYu's desired plugin-capability and interruptibility foundations.

candidates.name: N.E.K.O plugin permission grant store
candidates.outcome: selected; reuse a9a8fa11 instead of creating a XiaoYu permission/consent database

candidates.name: N.E.K.O plugin context propagation and execution budgets
candidates.outcome: selected; reuse e37250f9 instead of creating a private executor/context wrapper

candidates.name: N.E.K.O Windows system-presence reconnect handling
candidates.outcome: selected; reuse 6fccfb72 for display-state notification continuity

reviews.why_reuse_insufficient: These native additions strengthen capability hosting and presence continuity but do not expose an authoritative interruptibility provider arbitration hook, an equivalent-cost plugin model binding for the private semantic classifier, or the first-round main-conversation tool arbitration required to retire patches 0007/0009.

reviews.problem: The private interaction-policy plugin directly read host provider configuration and credentials to create its semantic classifier client, duplicating a capability now provided by N.E.K.O Plugin SDK model slots.

candidates.name: N.E.K.O Plugin SDK model gateway (ctx.models)
candidates.outcome: selected as the only classifier model invocation path; provider, endpoint, credentials, usage accounting and slot resolution remain host-owned

candidates.name: N.E.K.O ModelConfigService.ensure_host_follow_binding
candidates.outcome: selected for first-install binding; the short-lived installer synchronously reuses the native method only when the usage has never been touched

candidates.name: N.E.K.O agent_small host-follow slot
candidates.outcome: selected as the low-cost default for the classifier; later user-managed bindings and explicit unbinds are preserved

candidates.name: private get_model_api_config/create_chat_llm_async path
candidates.outcome: retired

reviews.why_reuse_insufficient: No external or private model runtime is required. The only private logic left is the XiaoYu-specific classification prompt, deterministic hard-control admission policy, and a one-time installer preference from the native default agent slot to the native agent_small slot.

candidates.name: N.E.K.O 6fccfb72 current stable pin
candidates.outcome: selected for continued live reuse; already fully promoted and validated while the newer candidate remains blocked

candidates.name: N.E.K.O e4f87d32 upstream candidate
candidates.outcome: deferred: 10/10 patches replay and core compatibility are green, but clean upstream reproduces the API-settings dropdown geometry failure

candidates.name: XiaoYu private frontend workaround
candidates.outcome: rejected; do not add private UI debt to compensate for an upstream-only regression

reviews.why_reuse_insufficient: The current stable upstream pin remains the selected native implementation. The newer candidate is deferred until its own frontend acceptance is green; no private workaround is justified.

reviews.problem: The interaction-policy plugin kept durable quiet/vision/cursor state in a private JSON file even though N.E.K.O Plugin SDK now provides a native plugin key-value store.

candidates.name: N.E.K.O PluginStore
candidates.outcome: selected as durable interaction-state authority; legacy JSON is imported once

candidates.name: private state.json durable authority
candidates.outcome: retired; only a rebuildable quiet projection remains for the synchronous final reply gate

reviews.why_reuse_insufficient: PluginStore fully replaces private durable state. A two-field projection file remains only because patch 0006 makes a synchronous final reply-admission decision in the main chat process and intentionally does not depend on plugin IPC/SQLite; the projection is derived and can be rebuilt from PluginStore.
